description: Per-module disposition registry for the wired-but-dead pub mods allowlisted in scripts/check_orphan_modules.py::WIRED_BUT_DEAD (Issue #3748). Every allowlist entry must carry exactly one row with an owner-assigned wire-or-delete decision; the registry must stay in lock-step with the live wired-but-dead set. Resolving a module (wiring it up or deleting it) requires dropping its row AND lowering BASELINE_WIRED_BUT_DEAD by one in the same PR.

Registered under its qualified path in PR #4647's 2026-11-11 rebase (the original branch registration used the bare leaf name, predating the Issue #4702 path-keying migration).
